data.notes: The report gets the core story right. Owen's payback request was answered with a generic ROI deck instead of 'a number that's ours', and the report surfaces it as the turning point about a month before the freeze. All four messaging changes match the key's direction. Its biggest misses: it uses 'Value proof' as the tag instead of 'No decision', and it never cites Renee's 'I don't think there was anything we could have done' as an opinion to rebut. It only implies the challenge in the rep takeaway, and it also omits 'I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.'
